notes:
Replication extracted from updated SI Appendix in institutional archive; source text contains separately labelled original and updated appendix versions. Original primary full text not acquired; original-study summaries in replication paper were not substituted for primary original evidence. Primary authors project spreadsheet acquired independently, but omnibus reduced-model rows were not substituted for differently specified effects. n is explicitly supplied in primary project final-analysis table; effect and p are from the same SI ANOVA. No explicit authors’ narrative replication-success verdict established for this particular effect; success is not inferred from significance.
Source follow-up: Original-only fresh validation using the supplied published article, pp. 68–87, not a manuscript or supplement. Supplied title and authors match canonical text. Rendered PDF pp. 8–9 and 11 inspected. Numeric meanings confirmed visually: narrative partial eta-squared .016 and exact p = .08 belong to F(1, 189) = 3.00. Canonical-text quotes retain h2p rather than normalizing its math-font extraction to the rendered Greek eta with superscript 2 and subscript p. The broad locator is resolved to the H5 three-way interaction on loan amount; purchase-intention four-way interaction and user-specific contrasts are separate tests. Internal published discrepancy: Table 3, p. 78 (PDF p. 11), Loan Amount, L × F × LO, instead prints 3.43* (.02), with * defined as p ≤ .10 (canonical extraction uses £). Those table values are not merged with the narrative test selected at the supplied PDF p. 9 locator. Study-level N = 199 is not substituted for an independently established test-specific analytic N. Replication and success verdict were not examined because they are unassigned.
